snippet.title: Bosslords - Announcement Trailer | Fantasy Roguelite Auto-Battler
snippet.description:
Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in Bosslords! Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!
